climate-security-2021-12-13.visible-2: India sought to preserve the universal, consensus-based decision-making process of the UNFCCC, arguing that most developing nations lack a voice in the Security Council. climate-security-2021-12-13.visible-3: Russia rejected an automatic climate-security link, preferring substantive work at the UNFCCC and a Sahel-specific draft addressing that region's unique insecurity. Both delegations favored the UNFCCC and a Sahel-focused approach.
